name: (01) Thaumaturgy (The Green Path) — 1 Basic — Herbal Wisdom

system.description: By touching a plant, you commune with its spirit, whose wisdom and insight vary with the nature of the plant. You may ask a single question and receive a true, if not always helpful, answer. To learn more, make a Static Mental Challenge against the Storyteller; success reveals further detail as the Storyteller sees fit.
